universe: 2018-2024 pre-holdout, entities with both momentum_12_1 and earnings_yield computable
notes: Power analysis on two metrics before any threshold frozen, variance only (scripts never call .mean()). Portfolio top-decile margin vs momentum-alone: std=4.657pts/qtr, needs ~87yr for true +2pt annualized effect at t>=2.0. Paired rank-IC difference (combo vs momentum-alone, same date): std=0.0848, needs ~8yr for true 0.03 diff, ~18-72yr for realistic 0.01-0.02 range. Neither metric reaches usable power at n=8 or any practical multiple. Conclusion: combination cannot be validated on this data at any reachable horizon -- not evidence the effect is absent, evidence the measurement is too noisy relative to plausible effect size. Final study slot NOT spent, held. earnings_yield own diagnostic findings (near-zero momentum correlation, IC holds outside momentum top decile, raw t=2.86 fails multiple-comparisons correction) unaffected.
